instruction: Add a star to every email in the local INBOX folder

rules.sql: select sum(1) > 0 from messageAttributes where attributeID = 58 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 1);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding star to all emails in INBOX folder (folderID=1). The evaluator checks if attributeID=58 (star attribute) is set to value=1 for messages in INBOX. Verified from database: INBOX has 2 emails.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical logic error: SQL query only checks if at least one email is starred (sum(1) > 0), not if ALL emails are starred
Instruction requires 'Add a star to every email' but evaluator will pass even if only 1 out of 2 emails is starred
Incomplete coverage: Missing verification that all 2 emails in INBOX have stars
Expected logic should verify: count(starred emails in INBOX) == count(all emails in INBOX), i.e., 2 == 2
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change SQL query to verify ALL emails are starred, e.g.: 'select (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 1) = (select count(distinct messageID) from messageAttributes where attributeID = 58 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 1));'
Alternative fix: 'select count(distinct messageID) = 2 from messageAttributes where attributeID = 58 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 1);' (hardcoded 2 emails)

Alternative fix: Use a more robust query that compares counts: 'select case when (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 1) = (select count(distinct ma.messageID) from messageAttributes ma join messages m on ma.messageID = m.id where m.folderID = 1 and ma.attributeID = 58 and ma.value = 1) then 1 else 0 end;'
